purpose: Operationalize 'better than a normal database for the model' as measured model-input utility rather than the false requirement that one custom engine beat mature databases on every primitive operation.

architecture_statement.unifieddb: canonical semantic/logical state, provenance, epochs, replay and transactions
architecture_statement.claygraph: derived/rebuildable navigation and topology projection; never truth authority
architecture_statement.model_surface: adaptive possibility/context preprocessor that compiles the smallest sufficient evidence/possibility field per query
architecture_statement.normal_database_role: retained as a physical primitive whenever it is Pareto-best, especially resolved exact-key access
architecture_statement.forbidden_interpretation: Do not claim universal database speed or accuracy superiority. Composite model-input dominance may use conventional database primitives internally.

hard_invariants: No graph activation, rank, lexical overlap or model proposal mints truth/proof/effect authority.
Source and graph/read generations are verified and pinned; stale/mixed basis fails closed.
Missing relation/edge semantics are UNKNOWN, not negative evidence.
CONFLICT/REVOKED/otherwise inadmissible nodes may be observed as negative space but may not relay activation or close evidence gaps.
A sufficient compiled field is never padded merely to fill k/context budget.
Graph deepening occurs only for explicit unresolved evidence requirements and stops on sufficiency/no novelty/budget.
Materialization/compilation occurs only when measured quality is non-regressed and guarded amortization predicts positive total-work savings before invalidation.
Unknown/ambiguous entity resolution cannot ignite graph traversal.
Negative results remain first-class and can force route fallback to conventional retrieval.

exact_resolved_key.required_behavior: Delegate to the strongest validated conventional exact-key primitive unless a candidate matches quality and wins total cost.
exact_resolved_key.current_adjudication: CONVENTIONAL_BTREE_WINS_PRIMITIVE_LATENCY; retain it inside the composite preprocessor.

semantic_snapshot_context.gate: No quality regression; strict win in precision/completeness or latency/context size on held-out current Clay queries.

entity_alias_and_ood.gate: Evidence-bound resolution must improve held-out decision accuracy with zero false-open on ambiguity/abstention controls.

relational_multihop.gate: Measure full evidence-chain recovery, not only partial recall. Query-conditioned traversal may be promoted only if poisoned/hub-rich chain completeness improves and clean/unlabeled/OOD completeness does not regress.

possibility_affordance.gate: Possibility synthesis must improve useful possibility coverage without increasing false possibilities or bypassing constraints/authority.

maintenance_and_churn.gate: If expected valid reads are below measured guarded break-even, use online/index path rather than compile/materialize. Dependency deltas must be quality-equivalent to full rebuild before promotion.

sufficiency_and_abstention.gate: Only explicit provenance-valid evidence may close a typed gap. Insufficient context must remain insufficient/abstain rather than be padded by graph or lexical noise.

composite_dominance_rule.quality_non_regression: For every declared workload class, candidate quality/safety metrics are >= strongest matched conventional/previous route within declared uncertainty; any statistically/materially meaningful regression blocks promotion.
composite_dominance_rule.strict_improvement: At least one material model-facing workload class must improve evidence completeness/decision accuracy/context efficiency/latency without worsening authority or recovery.
composite_dominance_rule.resource_rule: Compare end-to-end read + build/update/invalidation cost, not hot-query latency alone.
composite_dominance_rule.routing_rule: The composite is allowed to select the conventional primitive itself; dominance applies to the model-facing decision surface, not to replacement of every storage algorithm.
composite_dominance_rule.ood_rule: Held-out aliases, ambiguous entities, missing edge semantics, hub-heavy graphs, stale epochs, conflicts and concurrent invalidation are mandatory.
composite_dominance_rule.target_host_rule: Self-hosted Ubuntu evidence is required before H1/H2 promotion; final Andreas Ubuntu target evidence remains separate.

supported: semantic snapshot sufficiency field can beat matched FTS path on current bounded Clay snapshot stress
evidence-bound alias resolution can materially improve no-internal-id retrieval on a synthetic falsifier
compiled intent/entity fields can reduce repeated-query latency when amortization threshold is exceeded
flat unconditional graph depth/materialization are not universally beneficial and are actively rejected when measured worse
blocked: real broad held-out Clay natural-language corpus

next_discriminators: QCEP-0.2 self-hosted poison/clean/unlabeled graph differential plus U15 explicit-gap closure.
Held-out real Clay query set annotated by required evidence facets, ambiguity and complete reasoning chain.
Matched conventional suite: SQLite/FTS, PostgreSQL FTS+pgvector where available, and a simple graph traversal baseline under equal context budget.
Mixed-workload end-to-end benchmark that includes exact key, semantic family, alias/OOD, multihop, possibility and churn with route-selection overhead.
Model-use evaluation: answer/candidate selection quality with preprocessor context versus matched conventional context under the same token budget.
